name: Deploy

# REGRA: deploy somente a partir da branch main.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: deploy-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy to production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Guarda extra: mesmo via "Run workflow" (workflow_dispatch), só roda na main.
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment: production
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          coverage: none
          tools: composer:v2

      - name: Install Deployer
        run: composer global require deployer/deployer:^7.5

      - name: Add SSH key
        uses: webfactory/ssh-agent@v0.9.0
        with:
          ssh-private-key: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}

      - name: Trust the server host key
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          ssh-keyscan -H "${{ secrets.DEPLOY_HOST }}" >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

      - name: Deploy (Deployer)
        env:
          DEPLOY_REPOSITORY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_REPOSITORY }}
          DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_HOST }}
          DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
          DEPLOY_PHP_FPM: ${{ vars.DEPLOY_PHP_FPM }}
        run: ~/.composer/vendor/bin/dep deploy production -vvv
